At the 2026 Jornada Desert Ecology Short Course, the Jornada IM team will provide a tour of key Jornada datasets, and demonstrate how to access and use them with a variety of methods.

## Workshop details

**Date and time:** Wednesday, August 5th, 1:30 pm  
**Location:**  Wooton Hall Auditorium on NMSU campus ([directions](https://lter.jornada.nmsu.edu/contact-info/))  
**What to bring:** Bring a charged laptop and be ready to ask questions about the Jornada data that is most useful to you.
